{{Top|leg}}
The '''Council of Banking Clans''' was the governing body of the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. These [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] were involved in early financial dealings with the planet [[Bastion/Legends|Sartinaynian]]. Despite the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Speciesism|xenophobia]], the Council continued their business arrangements where they used vast stores of precious metals that bankrolled colonies, trading cults and other such investments along the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
